fnol_text: My name is Ethan Ferreira and I live at 787 Juniper Street, Riverton, WY 82587. You can reach me on (555) 741-5672 or ethan.ferreira@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 16 August 2024, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2023-00005. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mr Ferreira on (555) 741-5672 to acknowledge the claim. Ethan confirmed the loss date as 16 August 2024.
Site visit to 787 Juniper Street. Neighbour Esther Al-Sayed was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ethan sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
